CustomField.description: Clause of the regulation of the Criterion of Article 52 Section IV that represents whether the counterparty obtains 45 percent or more of its annual gross income from another counterparty
CustomField.formula: AND( ISPICKVAL(CRMX_Annual_Expenses__c, "FALSE"), ISPICKVAL(CRMX_Gross_Income__c, "TRUE"), ISPICKVAL(CRMX_Percentage__c, "Between 45% and 50%."), ISPICKVAL(CRMX_Credit_Rating__c, "TRUE"), OR( ISPICKVAL(CRMX_Risk_Grade__c, "Risk level 5"), ISPICKVAL(CRMX_Risk_Grade__c, "Risk level 6") ) )
CustomField.label: Case E
